operations.command:
set -e; mkdir -p {{workDir}}/fakebin {{workDir}}/tree/bin {{workDir}}/tree/scripts {{workDir}}/tree/secrets {{workDir}}/tree/.venv {{workDir}}/tree/.direnv {{workDir}}/home; printf '%s
' '[[audio]]' 'label = "Desk"' 'sink = "preset.sink"' 'volume = "40%"' > {{workDir}}/labels.toml; printf '%s
' '#!/bin/sh' 'if [ "$1" = "get-default-sink" ]; then echo preset.sink; exit 0; fi' 'cat <<EOF' '[' '  {' '    "name": "preset.sink",' '    "description": "Preset Description"' '  },' '  {' '    "name": "extra.sink",' '    "description": "Extra Speakers"' '  }' ']' 'EOF' > {{workDir}}/fakebin/pactl; chmod +x {{workDir}}/fakebin/pactl; printf '%s
' '#!/bin/sh' 'if [ "$1" = "status" ]; then echo "Secure Boot: enabled"; exit 0; fi' 'if [ "$1" = "verify" ] && [ "$2" = "--json" ]; then printf %s "{"/boot/EFI/Linux/good.efi":{"is_signed":true},"/boot/EFI/Linux/bad.efi":{"is_signed":false}}"; exit 0; fi' 'exit 0' > {{workDir}}/fakebin/sbctl; chmod +x {{workDir}}/fakebin/sbctl; touch {{workDir}}/tree/regular.txt {{workDir}}/tree/bin/tool {{workDir}}/tree/scripts/do {{workDir}}/tree/secrets/password {{workDir}}/tree/.venv/ignored {{workDir}}/tree/.direnv/ignored; chmod 600 {{workDir}}/tree/regular.txt {{workDir}}/tree/bin/tool {{workDir}}/tree/scripts/do {{workDir}}/tree/secrets/password {{workDir}}/tree/.venv/ignored {{workDir}}/tree/.direnv/ignored

set -e; env HOME={{workDir}}/home NIXOSCTL_ASSUME_ROOT_FOR_TESTS=true NIXOS_CONFIG_ROOT={{workDir}}/tree USER=$(id -un) ./build/nixosctl fix-permissions; mode() { if stat -c %a "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then stat -c %a "$1"; else stat -f %Lp "$1"; fi; }; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/regular.txt)" = 644; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/bin/tool)" = 755; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/scripts/do)" = 755; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/secrets/password)" = 600; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/.venv/ignored)" = 600; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/.direnv/ignored)" = 600; printf permissions-ok
